text:
Priya: Quick sync — proposing a 'mini-canary' observability surface for Console's next release. Goal: low-effort launch hooks that give product+SRE signal without doubling cost or dashboard work.
Marco: sounds good. What are the must-have signals for gating?
Priya: minimal gating: 1) frontend error-rate increase > 0.5% absolute, 2) 99th latency regressions > 200ms, 3) token-cost delta > 8% vs baseline. If all clear -> green.
Diego: For traces, can we do sampled trace hooks rather than full trace retention? e.g., 5% sampling plus error-biased capture.
Ava: +1 on sample+error bias. Also need a handful of templated dashboards: 1 page for latency/cost, 1 page for errors, 1 page for traces (sampled). Keep widgets tiny.
Priya: implementation notes: - sampling policy configurable per-route - cost attribution breakdown by model + route - lightweight trace snippets attached to error groups
Marco: how do we verify cost attribution accuracy during canary? need acceptance tests.
Diego: propose a smoke script that sends representative traffic (mix of short-chat, long-gen) and exports: total tokens, model selection counts, per-request cost. We compare to baseline within +/-8%.
Priya: yeah, add: automated smoke run as part of canary pipeline, results posted to #release-war-room with small report.
Ava: dashboard tiles I need: "Token cost by model", "P50/P95/P99 latency by route", "Error count trend with top error messages". Can we pre-populate with sample queries?
Priya: we'll provide sample queries. Also include a quick runbook blurb: when error spikes, toggle sampling to 100% for 5m to gather traces.
Diego: small config snippet suggestion for sampling policy:
```
sampling:
  default_pct: 5
  error_bias_pct: 50
  per_route_overrides:
    /chat: 10
    /embed: 1
```
Marco: rollout policy? probably staggered: 10% -> 40% -> 100% with 30m checks. Can we add auto-fallback to hosted smaller model if latency or cost spikes?
Priya: yes — add routing fallback to a compatible quantized variant as safety net. We'll document compatibility matrix.
ops-bot: deploy started for canary/mini-observe at 3923457800, job #887.
Ava: human acceptance: product owner needs to sign off on dashboard clarity + smoke run green. Ops to confirm sampling toggles are safe.
Priya: acceptance checklist to ship (short): [ ] smoke run green within +/-8% cost, [ ] dashboards populated with templates, [ ] tracing sample & error bias verified, [ ] auto-fallback verified in sim, [ ] runbook note + toggles tested.
Diego: I'll own smoke script + sampling config. Marco — can you own rollout windows and gating automation?
Marco: yep, I got rollout automation and alerts. I'll create the canary job in the pipeline.
Priya: thanks — aim to start canary Tues AM. If anything changes ping me or @ops-bot. :rocket:
